We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Creative Director (m/f/d) Your role

You own how fonio looks and sounds to the outside world. From our website to paid ads to our visual brand language - you set the standard and have the final say. You lead a small, high-impact creative team (Creative Strategist, Static Ads Designer, UI/UX Designer) and work closely with our Head of Content: she owns owned/organic, you own brand, paid, and web. We're B2B but want to build like a consumer brand - that's where you come in.

What to expect

 * You own fonio's entire visual and creative outward presence: brand, website, paid ads

 * You lead and grow a three-person creative team - setting direction and quality without micromanaging

 * You give final sign-off on creative output and hold a consistent standard across all channels

 * You stay hands-on enough to challenge concepts yourself and lead by example on quality

 * You report directly to our Director of Growth

Who we're looking for

 * Several years of experience as a Creative Director, Art Director, or in a comparable leadership role - ideally in a performance/brand environment

 * You've demonstrably built or sharpened brands and can show it through work, not just words

 * You enjoy leading but see yourself as an enabler, not a controller

 * You think brand and performance together - beautiful creative that doesn't convert isn't enough for you

 * German + very good English

What we offer

 * Competitive salary: €90,000-€150,000

 * Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - lunch and dinner are on us at the Vienna office (plus all the drinks you want, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit with the founders

Ready to leave your mark on a market? 

The France and Benelux market is still wide open - we're looking for someone who wants a say in how it's built, not just someone to execute someone else's playbook. If you want real ownership and a direct line to the people making decisions, keep reading.

You'll own the France & Benelux partner ecosystem from day one, while also managing leads and accounts for selected opportunities in DACH - with room to expand into additional markets as the business grows.

What you'll do

 * Grow and develop the partner network - distributors, resellers, system integrators - across France and Benelux: recruit new partners, and take the existing ones to the next level through account management and joint go-to-market planning.

 * Create your own pipeline - develop relationships with partners and end customers directly, routing opportunities through the right partners.

 * Enable partners to sell - product training, presentations, demos and POCs, and help them position the full PATCHBOX portfolio around standardization, efficiency, and easier infrastructure control.

 * Drive market development - work with Sales & Marketing on regional campaigns, exhibitions, and events, and help build installer communities and reference stories.

 * Manage leads and accounts for selected opportunities in DACH - working alongside our existing DACH team, with growing ownership as you gain experience.

What's in it for you

 * Real ownership of a market that's still mostly untapped - a few partners exist, but the network is yours to build and develop.

 * Direct access and visibility, including regular contact with our CEO.

 * A path to more markets, more influence, and more responsibility as you grow - where you take this in two years is largely up to you.

 * Benefits like extra days off, Wiener Linien Ticket and regular team events.

 * Annual salary: EUR 60,000-83,000 gross OTE.

What you bring

 * Several years of experience in sales, channel development, business development, or account management.

 * A proactive, hunter mindset - you create opportunities, you don't wait for them.

 * Strong communication skills; comfortable picking up the phone and engaging stakeholders at every level, from technical teams to senior leadership and C-suite, and building relationships with distributors, integrators, and end customers.

 * Self-organized and independent - you set your own priorities and drive your own schedule.

 * German: minimum C1 · French: minimum C1 · English: professional working proficiency.

Nice to have: experience in IT, networking, infrastructure, or data centers; familiarity with distributors/VARs/system integrators; CRM experience (HubSpot a plus).

1 In-House Programmatic Specialist (all genders)
1210 Wien, Job-ID: pze3wyxz 

Your responsibilities

 * End-to-End Campaign Trading & Optimization
You manage the daily setup, pacing, bidding strategies, and optimization of all programmatic display, video, audio, and connected TV (CTV) campaigns. You leverage platform-native bidding algorithms, frequency capping, and custom rules/scripts to consistently hit performance KPIs.
 * Marketplace Management & Publisher Relations
You negotiate directly with supply-side platforms (SSPs) and premium publishers to secure Private Marketplace (PMP) deals and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals that drive efficiency and scale for our campaigns.
 * Creative Management & Ad Operations
You traffic and manage creatives via CM360 (Google stack) or Trade Desk's native creative library, ensuring proper ad serving, rotation, and format compliance across display, video (VAST/VPAID), audio, and CTV formats.
 * Measurement, Attribution & Performance Dashboards
You build transparent, automated performance dashboards to track media costs, tech fees, and platform margins. You implement and maintain conversion measurement using Floodlight activities, CM360 attribution models, and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel & conversion events.
 * Stakeholder Communication & Community Leadership
You translate complex programmatic data into clear business insights for internal teams (Marketing, Creative, Leadership). You actively contribute to our internal Programmatic Community and share expertise across the organization.

Your qualifications

 * Deep Programmatic Trading Experience
You bring 3+ years of hands-on programmatic trading experience, with at least 2 years of intensive, daily work inside a DSP platform. Proficiency in one platform is required; working knowledge of multiple platforms is a strong advantage. Prior experience at a digital media agency or as a certified Google Marketing Platform (GMP) partner and/or Trade Desk certified partner is highly preferred.
 * Technical Expertise & Platform Mastery
You demonstrate complete fluency in Floodlight tags, CM360 container structures, URL parameters (Google stack) and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel, conversion event configuration, and tracking parameters. You understand the technical architecture behind modern programmatic advertising.
 * Advanced Analytics & Problem-Solving
You possess advanced skills in data analytics with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate them into actionable campaign strategies. You troubleshoot creative rejections, pixel drop-offs, and discrepancies across ad servers with ease and precision.
 * Communication & Team Collaboration
You communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders. You work independently and thrive as part of an English-speaking team, bringing both technical depth and interpersonal excellence. A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a quantitative field is a plus.

Your perspective

Depending on the specific qualifications and professional experience, a gross monthly salary of at least EUR 4.000,- is envisaged (this in any case exceeds the minimum salary under the collective agreement). The final salary agreement will be reached in a personal meeting.

At our client you enjoy and value the freedom of a flexible mix of working from home and in the office. You will also benefit from a flat hierarchy and a transparent company structure. The position is available at the earliest possible entry date. This may best be discussed in a job interview.
